fields.name: ThrottleTimeMs
fields.about: The duration in milliseconds for which the request was throttled due to a quota violation, or zero if the request did not violate any quota.

fields.name: ErrorCode
fields.about: The error code, or 0 if there was no error.

fields.name: ProducerEpoch
fields.about: The current epoch associated with the producer id.

fields.name: OngoingTxnProducerId
fields.about: The producer id for ongoing transaction when KeepPreparedTxn is used, -1 if there is no transaction ongoing.

fields.name: OngoingTxnProducerEpoch
fields.about: The epoch associated with the  producer id for ongoing transaction when KeepPreparedTxn is used, -1 if there is no transaction ongoing.
